name: Fogo Fátuo #5: Arte em Movimento
description: Fogo Fátuo #5 is a day dedicated to art in movement, featuring artists from various geographies who blend popular traditions with contemporary expressions. The program includes intimate acoustic performances and immersive audiovisual experiences presented in different locations within and outside the Galeria Municipal do Porto.
longDescription:
Fogo Fátuo #5 is an event dedicated to art in movement, bringing together artists from diverse backgrounds to explore the intersection of popular traditions and contemporary expressions. The program for this autumn edition features both installed works and live actions.

Performances include 'As Vozes de Manhouce' at 15:30, 'Thomias Radin, Alexander Brack, Matthias Meisen' at 16:05, 'Lukas Karvelis' at 16:25, 'Jacopo Benassi | Khan of Finland' at 17:00, 'Jejuno' at 18:00, 'Serpente' at 18:30, 'Soraya Lutangu Bonaventure' at 19:00, and 'Doorman' at 20:00. Permanent installations by Sohrab Hura and Brahim Tall will be available from 15:00.

The event takes place on October 31, 2026, from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Galeria Municipal do Porto. Admission is free.
